sample_unit: clinicians (medical professionals classifying 100 EEG samples with and without AI)

links.outcome: Clinician EEG pattern classification accuracy with versus without AI assistance
links.effect: Mean user diagnostic accuracy improved from 47 to 71% (P<0.04) with AI assistance among eight medical professionals.
links.quote: Mean user diagnostic accuracy improved from 47 to 71% (P<0.04).

unlisted_practices: Using inherently interpretable case-based (prototype) explanations in deep learning models to support human-AI collaboration

screen.reason: The study conducts a reader study comparing clinician diagnostic performance on EEG pattern classification with versus without interpretable AI assistance providing case-based explanations.

primary.practice: interpretable AI assistance / clinician decision support with case-based explanations
